entries.name: Aural rehabilitation
entries.definition: Therapy and training that help people with hearing loss communicate, using residual hearing, hearing devices, speech-reading and communication strategies.

entries.name: Aurelia
entries.definition: An open-source JavaScript front-end framework for building single-page web applications.

entries.name: Author-it
entries.definition: Software for writing, managing and publishing technical documentation and other content from reusable components.

entries.name: Authorised capital
entries.definition: The maximum amount of share capital a company is permitted to issue under its constitutional documents.

entries.name: Autism therapy
entries.definition: Providing therapies and interventions, such as applied behavior analysis and speech, occupational and social-skills therapy, for people on the autism spectrum.

entries.name: Auto glass installation and repair
entries.definition: Replacing and repairing vehicle windshields and windows, including removing damaged glass and bonding in new glass.

entries.name: Autodesk 123D
entries.definition: A discontinued family of free Autodesk apps for 3D modelling, scanning and digital fabrication.

entries.name: Automated information systems security
entries.definition: The protection of computer-based information systems and the data they process, a term used in US government and military guidance.

entries.name: Automotive detailing
entries.definition: Thoroughly cleaning, polishing and protecting the interior and exterior of a vehicle.

entries.name: Automotive finance
entries.definition: The field of financing vehicle purchases and leases, including the loans, leases, lenders and dealers involved.

entries.name: Automotive loans
entries.definition: Loans taken out to buy a vehicle, usually secured by the vehicle itself.

entries.name: Autonomic nervous system
entries.definition: The part of the nervous system that regulates involuntary body functions such as heart rate, digestion and breathing.

entries.name: Autoregressive integrated moving average
entries.definition: A statistical time-series model that forecasts a series from its own past values and past forecast errors, after differencing the series to remove trends.

entries.name: Autoshade
entries.definition: A discontinued Autodesk add-on for producing shaded, rendered images of AutoCAD models.

entries.name: AvantGo
entries.definition: A discontinued service that delivered web content and enterprise applications to handheld devices such as Palm and Pocket PC PDAs.

entries.name: AVEVA PI System
entries.definition: A data infrastructure for collecting, storing and analysing real-time industrial process data, originally from OSIsoft and now sold by AVEVA.

entries.name: Aviation medical examination
entries.definition: Performing medical examinations to decide whether pilots and other aviation personnel meet the medical standards required for flying duties.

entries.name: Avid Elastic Reality
entries.definition: A discontinued Avid application for warping and morphing images and video.

entries.name: Avid Media Composer
entries.definition: Avid's professional non-linear video-editing software.

entries.name: Amazon Web Services
entries.definition: A cloud-services platform; product-specific skills remain distinct.

entries.name: AWS big data
entries.definition: Using Amazon Web Services' data analytics and big data services, such as EMR, Redshift and Kinesis, to store and process large datasets.

entries.name: AWS Cloud9
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services cloud-based integrated development environment for writing, running and debugging code in a web browser.

entries.name: AWS CloudFormation
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service that provisions and manages cloud resources from templates written in JSON or YAML.

entries.name: AWS CloudHSM
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service that provides dedicated hardware security modules in the cloud for generating and storing cryptographic keys.

entries.name: AWS CloudTrail
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service that records actions taken in an AWS account, such as API calls, for auditing and security analysis.

entries.name: AWS CodeBuild
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service that compiles source code, runs tests and produces build artifacts.

entries.name: AWS CodeCommit
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service that hosts private Git repositories.

entries.name: AWS Command Line Interface
entries.definition: A command-line tool from Amazon Web Services for managing and automating AWS services from a terminal or script.

entries.name: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services service that deploys and scales web applications and handles provisioning, load balancing and monitoring.

entries.name: AWS IoT
entries.definition: Amazon Web Services' set of services for connecting Internet of Things devices to the cloud and managing the data they send.

entries.name: AWS Lambda
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services compute service that runs code in response to events without the user provisioning or managing servers.

entries.name: AWS networking
entries.definition: Designing and operating network connectivity on Amazon Web Services, using services such as Virtual Private Cloud, Route 53 and Direct Connect.

entries.name: AWS OpsWorks
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services configuration management service that uses Chef and Puppet to automate how servers are configured and deployed.

entries.name: AWS Outposts
entries.definition: An Amazon Web Services offering that installs AWS-managed infrastructure and services in a customer's own data center or facility.

entries.name: AWS SDK
entries.definition: Amazon Web Services' software development kits, available for languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java and Go, for calling AWS services from application code.

entries.name: AWS serverless
entries.definition: Building and running applications on Amazon Web Services with managed, event-driven services such as AWS Lambda, without provisioning or managing servers.

entries.name: Axios
entries.definition: A promise-based JavaScript HTTP client library for web browsers and Node.js.

entries.name: Azure Application Insights
entries.definition: A Microsoft Azure application performance monitoring service that collects telemetry such as requests, failures and traces from running applications.

entries.name: Azure Cognitive Services
entries.definition: A set of Microsoft cloud APIs for adding vision, speech, language and decision-making features to applications.

entries.name: Azure Data Factory
entries.definition: A Microsoft Azure cloud service for building and scheduling data-integration pipelines that move and transform data.
